Tooltip_GodSystem_SystemRepairKit: Single use. Fully repairs the held item body or handle, head durability, and sharpness when supported. Compatible with standard B42 durability APIs; custom durability systems may not be supported.
Tooltip_GodSystem_DurabilityCore: Single use. Permanently increases the held item body or handle maximum durability by 2 and current durability by 2. Repeatable. Does not increase head durability maximum.
Tooltip_GodSystem_StorageContainer: Capacity 500, weight reduction 99%. Uses the dedicated Storage Container body slot and can be worn, moved, and stored normally.
Tooltip_GodSystem_SystemVehicleRepairMod: Single use. Right-click a target vehicle while holding it to repair the vehicle and missing standard parts. Does not add fuel or change vehicle inventory.
Tooltip_GodSystem_SystemAutoLoader: Converts loose carried ammunition into a digital reserve by ammo type and can load matching magazines.
Tooltip_GodSystem_LotteryTicketFood: Right-click to use. This legacy category ticket now performs one full random draw after the cache is ready.
